programs.name: Computer Science (OUAC code ECS, Faculty of Science)
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum average of B in 3 distinct A-Levels (or 4 distinct AS-Levels) plus a minimum of C in 5 GCSE/IGCSE/O-Level subjects; for the best chance of admission, predicted results of at least BBB. This is the general GCE requirement; Western publishes no program-specific A-Level offer.
programs.ib_offer: Complete IB Diploma (six subjects, three at HL, no mark below 4, total of at least 27 including Extended Essay and TOK). Students admitted to Computer Science typically had averages of 30 to 32.
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma: at least 4.0 full senior academic courses on the transcript, typically at least a B (3.0) average; AP courses taken at school count toward the admission average. Required: Math and a Science (any), at AP or senior level. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027 (if submitted: SAT 1190 or ACT 24 minimum). AP exams alone cannot gain admission; AP exam scores of 4 or higher can earn transfer credit (up to 2.0 credits).
programs.required_subjects: A-Level: Math and a Science (any). IB: any Math and any Science, HL or SL. US/AP: Math and a Science (any). Ontario high school: ENG4U, MCV4U, MHF4U and one of MDM4U, SBI4U, SCH4U, SPH4U, SES4U or ICS4U.
programs.toefl_note: Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 83 overall, minimum 20 in each section. Tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall, at least 4.0 in reading, speaking and writing and 4.5 in listening.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each section; PTE Academic 58 overall with 56 per section; Duolingo 115 overall with 100 per subscore; Cambridge C1/C2 176 overall with 169 per section. Tests must be taken before March 2027 and not before 1 January 2025. Waiver possible after 4 years of full-time English-medium secondary school.
programs.notes: Admission average guideline for Ontario high school students: low to mid 80s. Duration listed as 3-5 years. Degree types listed: BMSc, BSc, Combined BSc & HBA (Ivey). The OUAC deadline of January 15, 2027 is the equal-consideration date; later applications are accepted but space is not guaranteed (https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/apply/admission-deadlines.html and https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/apply/apply-on-the-ouac.html). Ivey Advanced Entry Opportunity (AEO) is a separate application with a January 15, 2027 deadline on the same deadlines page; Ivey states students can study anything in their first two years, and the program page lists a combined BSc & HBA for Computer Science. Fee: 2026-27 international tuition for Computer Science Years 1-3, CAD 55,167.00; the schedule is marked DRAFT (fees may change without notice), Fall 2027 rates were not published, and ancillary fees and UHIP are extra (https://www.registrar.uwo.ca/student_finances/fees_refunds/2026-27-UGRD-Fee-Schedule---FT-International1.pdf). IB route: https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/requirements/international-baccalaureate.html . A-Level route: https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/requirements/international-high-school/united-kingdom.html . AP / US route: https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/requirements/international-high-school/united-states.html and https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/requirements/international-high-school/advanced-placement.html . English: https://welcome.uwo.ca/next-steps/requirements/english-language-proficiency.html .

programs.name: Economics (Faculty of Social Science, OUAC code EO)

This is the general GCE requirement; Western publishes no program-specific A-Level offer.
programs.ib_offer: Complete IB Diploma (six subjects, three at HL, no mark below 4, total of at least 27 including Extended Essay and TOK). Students admitted to Social Science typically had averages of 28 to 32.
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma: at least 4.0 full senior academic courses on the transcript, typically at least a B (3.0) average; AP courses taken at school count toward the admission average. No required courses for Social Science, but Calculus and Pre-Calculus are needed for all Economics modules. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027 (if submitted: SAT 1190 or ACT 24 minimum). AP exams alone cannot gain admission; AP exam scores of 4 or higher can earn transfer credit (up to 2.0 credits).
programs.required_subjects: No required courses for admission to Social Science. Recommended: Math; Calculus and Pre-Calculus are needed for all Economics modules (IB: Math Applications and Interpretation HL, or Math Analysis and Approaches SL or HL). Ontario high school: ENG4U.
programs.toefl_note: Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 83 overall, minimum 20 in each section. Tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall, at least 4.0 in reading, speaking and writing and 4.5 in listening.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each section; PTE Academic 58 overall with 56 per section; Duolingo 115 overall with 100 per subscore; Cambridge C1/C2 176 overall with 169 per section. Tests must be taken before March 2027 and not before 1 January 2025. Waiver possible after 4 years of full-time English-medium secondary school.
programs.notes: Admission is to the Faculty of Social Science (Economics is chosen as a module/specialization); the admission average guideline for Ontario high school students is low to mid 80s. Duration listed as 3-5 years. Degree types listed: BA, BSc, Combined BA & HBA (Ivey). Ivey Advanced Entry Opportunity (AEO) is a separate application with a January 15, 2027 deadline on the same page; the program page lists a combined BA & HBA. Fee: 2026-27 international tuition for the Social Science, Science (excluding Computer Science) row, Years 1-3, CAD 47,493.00; the schedule is marked DRAFT (fees may change without notice), Fall 2027 rates were not published, and ancillary fees and UHIP are extra (https://www.registrar.uwo.ca/student_finances/fees_refunds/2026-27-UGRD-Fee-Schedule---FT-International1.pdf). programs.name: Engineering (common first year, OUAC code EE, Faculty of Engineering)
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum average of B in 3 distinct A-Levels (or 4 distinct AS-Levels) plus a minimum of C in 5 GCSE/IGCSE/O-Level subjects; for the best chance of admission, predicted results of at least BBB. This is the general GCE requirement; Western publishes no program-specific A-Level offer.
programs.ib_offer: Complete IB Diploma (six subjects, three at HL, no mark below 4, total of at least 27 including Extended Essay and TOK). Students admitted to Engineering typically had averages of 33 to 35.
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma: at least 4.0 full senior academic courses on the transcript, typically at least a B (3.0) average; AP courses taken at school count toward the admission average. Required: Chemistry, Physics and Calculus (AP or senior level). The Casper test is also required. SAT/ACT optional for Fall 2027 (if submitted: SAT 1190 or ACT 24 minimum). AP exams alone cannot gain admission; AP exam scores of 4 or higher can earn transfer credit (up to 2.0 credits).
programs.required_subjects: A-Level: Chemistry, Physics and Math. IB: Chemistry and Physics (HL or SL) plus Math Analysis and Approaches (HL or SL) or Math Applications and Interpretation (HL only). US/AP: Chemistry, Physics and Calculus. Ontario high school: ENG4U, MHF4U, MCV4U, SCH4U, SPH4U.
programs.admissions_test: Casper (online situational judgement test, required for Engineering; the last test date is March 2, 2027)
programs.toefl_note: Tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 83 overall, minimum 20 in each section. Tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall, at least 4.0 in reading, speaking and writing and 4.5 in listening.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each section; PTE Academic 58 overall with 56 per section; Duolingo 115 overall with 100 per subscore; Cambridge C1/C2 176 overall with 169 per section. Tests must be taken before March 2027 and not before 1 January 2025. Waiver possible after 4 years of full-time English-medium secondary school.
programs.notes: Western Engineering has a common first year (stated on the program page) before choosing a discipline. Ivey Advanced Entry Opportunity (AEO) is a separate application with a January 15, 2027 deadline on the same page; the program page lists BESc + HBA. Fee: 2026-27 international tuition for Engineering, Year 1, CAD 64,310.00; the schedule is marked DRAFT (fees may change without notice), Fall 2027 rates were not published, and ancillary fees and UHIP are extra (https://www.registrar.uwo.ca/student_finances/fees_refunds/2026-27-UGRD-Fee-Schedule---FT-International1.pdf).
